text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I did……… itttttt!! I did it, I did it, 
hoorayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: 1st place! Trainer, I got 1st place!

In a GⅠ race where there's no faking it, 
she brilliantly took 1st place. It was 
unequivocally Haru Urara's own true 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, do you think with this... I can 
enter the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Can I really enter...?

She looks anxious, surely because she 
understands a little better now than 
before what it truly means to run in the 
Arima Kinen.
In that case, all I can say is...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: The surroundings...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: —Waaah...!

text_block_list.name: Roar of the Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Haru Uraraaa! Congratulations! Great job 
out there! You gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I heard you wanna run in the Arima Kinen! 
I'm rootin' for ya!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was a great race! I'm definitely 
voting for you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Amazing, everyone is cheering for me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm allowed to run... I can really race, 
right!
choice_data_list: We're definitely entering the Arima Kinen!
Let's definitely run in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

For a while after, the cheering voices 
supporting her never stopped...

On the way back, after walking Haru Urara 
to her dorm—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Urara-chan!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aaaand, congrats on 1st place~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wah, Spe-chan, Sei-chan! Ehehe, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah... Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan, Sei-chan, do you want to run 
in the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm totally planning on 
entering. And... I'm planning on winning, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, I want to win the Arima Kinen 
too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "That's why, I... All of us—!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! We are rivals!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah, we're rivals!

Both of them were staring straight at Haru 
Urara. Their eyes... were dead serious.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! I'll beat both of them and 
take 1st place!

—And so, it was decided to aim for 
entering the Arima Kinen!
